GST Council to meet Oct 7 for process reforms

The Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council is scheduled to convene on October 7. The meeting's agenda will primarily focus on process reforms for businesses. Key areas of discussion are expected to include invoice matching, Input Tax Credit (ITC), and the MDR tax on UPI transactions.
